purpose: Verified plotting extract; no manuscript or result regeneration; no optimization.
units: percent of each setting and instance strip-plan expected NPV
normalization: 100 * raw_difference / abs(methods.rn.enpv); all selected denominators are positive

source_procedure.sort_order: filename, which orders seeds ascending within each tolerance

fs_gap_ce.kind: CE gap of oracle first year under optimized continuation
fs_gap_ce.note: Whiskers are bootstrap intervals of lower-bound point differences, not the solver certificate interval.

gain_tilt1.kind: full-plan CE residual over one-iteration tilted MIP
gain_tilt1.note: Do not use gain_tilt2 or gain_family; tilt1 has no certified optimal-continuation first-year row.

rn_vss.kind: expected NPV gain from stochastic first-year planning, both first years with optimized risk-neutral continuation

paired_margin_control.denominator: each setting own E(zN), not common base denominator

plot_warnings: Keep panel C sample size visibly distinct: n=10 paired areas versus n=30 in panels A/B.
Panel C bootstrap intervals are descriptive.
Panel C denominators vary by setting.
Panel A/B differences are CE; panel C is expected NPV.
Do not stack or treat the three comparisons as additive.
Do not clamp per-instance negatives or drop zero-gain instances.
Use dots plus whiskers if the 0.05% residual is invisible as a bar.
